hook: Nabız: a free menu bar app
hookText: Nabız: a free menu bar app

beats.say: Nabız is an open-source native macOS menu bar app that lists running dev servers and ports, tracks Claude, Codex and Grok limits, and cleans build and agent leftovers like DerivedData.
The author built it after finding 62 GB of agent leftovers and three forgotten dev servers on his Mac.
Nabız includes a built-in MCP server so Claude Code can reuse what is already running, shows projects with unpushed commits plus Docker and simulators, and skips caches still in use and.env files.
